// One-bit PS/2 keyboard arrow key decoder
module TopModule(
  input  [15:0] scancode,
  output left,
  output down,
  output right,
  output up
);
  reg [15:0] last2 [0:1];
  always @(*) begin
    last2[0] = scancode;
    last2[1] = last2[0];
  end
  always @(*) begin
    case (last2)
      16'he06b: begin left = 1; down = 0; right = 0; up = 0; end // left
      16'he072: begin left = 0; down = 1; right = 0; up = 0; end // down
      16'he074: begin left = 0; down = 0; right = 1; up = 0; end // right
      16'he075: begin left = 0; down = 0; right = 0; up = 1; end // up
      default:  begin left = 0; down = 0; right = 0; up = 0; end // none
    endcase
  end
endmodule
